title: DataAccessibility
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Accessibility inherent-and-system data quality characteristic. The degree to which data can be accessed in a specific context of use, particularly by people who need assistive technology or special configuration because of some disability. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent and System-Dependent Data Quality — Accessibility).

accessibilityLevel.description: Degree of data accessibility. RESTRICTED = limited to specific accounts. ROLE_BASED = access determined by role/permission. BROADLY_ACCESSIBLE = available to most authorized users. UNIVERSALLY_ACCESSIBLE = available to all including assistive technology users.

apiAccessAvailable.description: Whether data is accessible via programmatic API.

assistiveTechnologySupport.description: Whether data presentation supports assistive technologies (screen readers, alternative formats).
